title: The Filled Form You Sent Is Still Editable — Flatten It Before It Leaves Your Pipeline
summary:
A client operations lead forwarded me a "completed" onboarding form last week with a note: "Signed and finalized, please archive." I clicked into the tax ID field and typed a character. It accepted it.
The form looked finished. Every field was filled, the signature was in place, it rendered perfectly. But nothing about it was locked — every AcroForm field was still live, which means anyone downstream could change a bank detail, a date, or a name, and the archived copy would show no trace of it.

summary:

title: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now supports direct querying of Apache Iceberg and Parquet data in your data lake
summary: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now lets you directly query Apache Iceberg and Parquet data stored in your data lake alongside live operational data—no ETL pipelines required. It supports AWS Glue Data Catalog, S3, and S3 Tables, with optimizations like predicate pushdown and caching for efficient performance.
